items.description: Leak detection and bathroom wall opening
items.rationale: The indoor supply-pipe fracture is insured under §1.1, and §2.1 covers both locating the leak and opening the wall. Two hours at €95 gross per hour gives €190.

items.description: Replace split 15 mm copper pipe section and fittings
items.rationale: Section 2.2 covers the localized pipe repair. Allow €180 gross for the installed short copper section and standard fittings, excluding wall access and reinstatement billed separately.

items.description: Close, re-plaster and re-tile the 0.2 m² wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 2.1 and 2.3 cover closing the opening and restoring the plaster and tiles to their prior condition. Allow €240 gross for the small patch, including labour and materials, with no allowance for undamaged tiling.

items.description: Annual gas boiler service and descaling
items.rationale: Section 3.1 expressly excludes servicing and descaling even during the same visit, and the boiler work is unrelated to the leak. The €200 gross figure is a conditional price estimate only, not a payable amount.
